nodes.label: Bread Daemon (breadd)
nodes.description: Long-running Rust process that ingests signals, maintains runtime state, and dispatches events to Lua modules.

nodes.label: Bread CLI
nodes.description: Command-line interface that communicates with the daemon over a Unix socket.

nodes.label: Lua Runtime
nodes.description: Dedicated thread inside the daemon that executes automation logic and loads user modules.

nodes.label: Bread Automation API v1
nodes.description: The versioned, stable contract covering Lua API, IPC methods, event vocabulary, and runtime-state schema.

nodes.label: Hyprland Adapter
nodes.description: Adapter that interfaces with Hyprland compositor IPC to deliver compositor events and state.

nodes.label: Udev Adapter
nodes.description: Adapter that interfaces with Linux udev to deliver hardware hotplug and device events.

nodes.label: Power Adapter
nodes.description: Adapter that monitors power state via UPower and sysfs.

nodes.label: Network Adapter
nodes.description: Adapter that monitors network state via rtnetlink and sysfs.

nodes.label: Bluetooth Adapter
nodes.description: Adapter that interfaces with BlueZ to manage Bluetooth devices and events.

nodes.label: Bread Module
nodes.description: A Lua script that implements automation logic, loaded from ~/.config/bread/modules/.

nodes.label: bread.module.toml
nodes.description: Manifest file that declares a module's name, version, description, author, and installation metadata.

nodes.label: Event Subscription (bread.on)
nodes.description: Core API to subscribe to matching events with a callback function.

nodes.label: One-time Event (bread.once)
nodes.description: Subscribe to an event once; the handler is removed after the first match.

nodes.label: Event Pattern Matching
nodes.description: Wildcard matching for events using *, **, and ? in dot-separated event names.

nodes.label: Coroutine Wait (bread.wait)
nodes.description: Coroutine-only helper that suspends until a matching event arrives, with optional timeout.

nodes.label: Wait Any (bread.wait_any)
nodes.description: Coroutine-only wait that resolves on the first of several event patterns to match.

nodes.label: Wait All (bread.wait_all)
nodes.description: Coroutine-only wait that resolves once every listed pattern has fired at least once.

nodes.label: Spawn Coroutine (bread.spawn)
nodes.description: Spawn a coroutine and surface errors if it fails, required for using bread.wait.

nodes.label: Workflow Definition (bread.workflow.define)
nodes.description: Register a multi-step automation workflow body under a name.

nodes.label: Start Workflow (bread.workflow.start)
nodes.description: Run a registered workflow as a coroutine with optional deadline and arguments.

nodes.label: Workflow Step (bread.workflow.step)
nodes.description: Record current step label in a running workflow for observability.

nodes.label: Workflow Status (bread.workflow.status)
nodes.description: Query the current status of a named workflow including state, step, and error information.

nodes.label: Register Widget (bread.widget.register)
nodes.description: Register a declarative widget with a typed node tree for rendering in sibling apps like breadbar.

nodes.label: Update Widget (bread.widget.update)
nodes.description: Patch an already-registered widget, replacing the root tree or updating metadata.

nodes.label: Remove Widget (bread.widget.remove)
nodes.description: Remove a widget registered by the calling module.

nodes.label: Widget Node Types
nodes.description: Typed node vocabulary for widgets: box, label, icon, progress with style and click handlers.

nodes.label: Widget Style Vocabulary
nodes.description: Bounded, typed vocabulary for node appearance: color, weight, size, align, background, radius, padding.

nodes.label: Read State (bread.state.get)
nodes.description: Read a state subtree by dotted path from the runtime state.

nodes.label: Watch State (bread.state.watch)
nodes.description: Watch a state path for changes and receive (new_value, old_value) on each change.

nodes.label: State Typed Shorthands
nodes.description: Convenience functions like bread.state.monitors(), power(), network(), etc.

nodes.label: Activate Profile (bread.profile.activate)
nodes.description: Activate a named profile and emit a profile.activated event.

nodes.label: Execute Command (bread.exec)
nodes.description: Run a shell command asynchronously (fire-and-forget, does not block Lua).

nodes.label: Execute and Capture (bread.exec_capture)
nodes.description: Run a shell command and return its exit status and captured stdout, blocks Lua.

nodes.label: Send Notification (bread.notify)
nodes.description: Send a desktop notification via notify-send with optional title, urgency, timeout, and icon.

nodes.label: Timer After (bread.after)
nodes.description: Run a callback once after a specified delay in milliseconds.

nodes.label: Timer Every (bread.every)
nodes.description: Run a callback on a repeating interval in milliseconds.

nodes.label: Debounce Function (bread.debounce)
nodes.description: Return a wrapper function that fires only after specified milliseconds of quiet time.

nodes.label: Logging Functions
nodes.description: bread.log(), bread.warn(), and bread.error() for outputting to daemon logs.

nodes.label: Machine Name (bread.machine.name)
nodes.description: Get the system hostname, with optional override from ~/.config/bread/sync.toml.

nodes.label: Machine Tags (bread.machine.tags)
nodes.description: Get machine tags from sync.toml for conditional behavior across multiple systems.

nodes.label: Filesystem Operations
nodes.description: bread.fs functions: write, read, exists, readlink, expand for file operations.

nodes.label: JSON Decode (bread.json.decode)
nodes.description: Parse a JSON string into a Lua table, returns nil on malformed input.

nodes.label: Hyprland API (bread.hyprland.*)
nodes.description: Namespace providing compositor bindings: dispatch, keyword, state queries, and raw event subscription.

nodes.label: Bluetooth API (bread.bluetooth.*)
nodes.description: Control local Bluetooth adapter and paired devices via BlueZ D-Bus with graceful degradation.

nodes.label: Module Lifecycle Hooks
nodes.description: Optional callbacks: on_load, on_reload, on_unload, on_error for module behavior control.

nodes.label: Module Storage (M.store)
nodes.description: Per-module key-value storage that survives hot reload but not daemon restart.

nodes.label: Built-in: monitors Module
nodes.description: High-level declarative monitor event handlers with layout registration and application.

nodes.label: Built-in: devices Module
nodes.description: Device connection rules with name-based matching from devices.lua.

nodes.label: Built-in: workspaces Module
nodes.description: Workspace-to-monitor assignment and app pinning for Hyprland.

nodes.label: Built-in: binds Module
nodes.description: Runtime keybind management via Hyprland dispatch with add, remove, replace operations.

nodes.label: System Startup Event
nodes.description: bread.system.startup event fired when Bread starts up.

nodes.label: Device Connection Events
nodes.description: bread.device.connected/disconnected events for USB and Bluetooth devices with full metadata.

nodes.label: Monitor Connection Events
nodes.description: bread.monitor.connected/disconnected events for display connections.

nodes.label: Window Management Events
nodes.description: bread.window events for focus, open, close, and move operations.

nodes.label: Power Events
nodes.description: bread.power events for AC connection, battery state, and low battery warnings.

nodes.label: Network Events
nodes.description: bread.network.connected/disconnected events with online status and interface info.

nodes.label: System Events
nodes.description: bread.profile.activated, bread.notify.sent, and bread.state.changed.* events.

nodes.label: Widget Events
nodes.description: bread.widget.* events for registered, updated, removed, and cleared widgets.

nodes.label: Terminal Events
nodes.description: bread.terminal.command.* and bread.terminal.cwd.* events from shell precmd/preexec hooks.

nodes.label: Git Events
nodes.description: bread.git.commit.created, bread.git.state.*, and ahead_behind changes from git hooks and polling.

nodes.label: Container Events
nodes.description: bread.container events for Podman container lifecycle and health changes.

nodes.label: Namespace Convention (bread.<app>.*)
nodes.description: Reserved naming convention for events published by sibling bread* applications.

nodes.label: Command Convention (bread.command.<app>.<verb>)
nodes.description: Convention for outbound commands to sibling applications, best-effort delivery.

nodes.label: Runtime State Schema
nodes.description: The complete JSON schema for RuntimeState including monitors, workspaces, devices, network, power, and more.

nodes.label: IPC Protocol
nodes.description: JSON-RPC over Unix socket at $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/bread/breadd.sock with methods for state, modules, profiles, events.

nodes.label: IPC Methods
nodes.description: Available IPC methods: ping, health, state.get, state.dump, modules.list, profile.activate, events.subscribe, emit, workflows.list, widgets.list.

nodes.label: breadd.toml Configuration
nodes.description: Daemon configuration file at ~/.config/bread/breadd.toml with optional settings for adapters, events, modules.

nodes.label: init.lua Entry Point
nodes.description: Lua entry point at ~/.config/bread/init.lua loaded first before modules.

nodes.label: devices.lua Device Mapping
nodes.description: User-defined device name to hardware mapping for stable device identification.

nodes.label: modules/ Directory
nodes.description: Directory at ~/.config/bread/modules/ where modules are auto-discovered and loaded.

nodes.label: Example: Dock Connected Workflow
nodes.description: Multi-step automation workflow for dock connection with monitor setup, profile activation, and notifications.

nodes.label: Example 1: Keyboard and Display Watcher
nodes.description: Port of shell script for Redox keyboard detection and external monitor handling.

nodes.label: Example 2: Autostart
nodes.description: System startup sequence with multiple commands executed on bread.system.startup.

nodes.label: Example 3: Display Monitors
nodes.description: Monitor layout management using Hyprland keywords and monitor connection events.

nodes.label: Example 5: CPU Temperature Widget
nodes.description: Live widget in breadbar showing CPU temperature with color styling and progress visualization.

nodes.label: Module: Low Battery Warning
nodes.description: Critical notification when battery runs low, resets on AC power.

nodes.label: Module: Pause Media on Headphone Unplug
nodes.description: Runs playerctl pause when headphone/earbud device disconnects.

nodes.label: Module: Dock Monitors Layout
nodes.description: Applies multi-monitor layout when external display connects, reverts when removed.

nodes.label: Module: Active Window Widget
nodes.description: Shows focused window next to workspace pills in breadbar using bread.widget and bread.state.watch.

nodes.label: Module: CPU Temp Widget
nodes.description: Live CPU temperature readout in breadbar's stats area with hwmon file reading.

nodes.label: Module: Bluetooth Toggle Widget
nodes.description: One-click Bluetooth power toggle in breadbar's tray with click event handling.

nodes.label: Module: Focus Mode Widget
nodes.description: Click-to-toggle Focus profile that mutes audio, syncs with profile changes.

nodes.label: Module: Workflow Status Widget
nodes.description: Surfaces bread.workflow.list() in breadbar tray showing running or failed workflows.

nodes.label: Module: Git Branch Widget
nodes.description: Shows repo and branch of focused kitty tab with dirty state indicator.

nodes.label: CI: dev-release Workflow
nodes.description: Triggered on push to main; builds, tests, and publishes dev-track build with auto-computed version.

nodes.label: CI: rc-release Workflow
nodes.description: Triggered on vX.Y.Z-rc.N tag push; builds and publishes beta-track RC build.

nodes.label: CI: release Workflow
nodes.description: Triggered on vX.Y.Z tag push; builds, tests, publishes stable release, and uploads to GitHub.

nodes.label: Release Track: dev
nodes.description: Bleeding-edge track published on every push to main with auto-computed version.

nodes.label: Release Track: beta
nodes.description: Latest release candidate track published from vX.Y.Z-rc.N tags.

nodes.label: Release Track: stable
nodes.description: Latest stable release published from vX.Y.Z tags.

nodes.label: Bakery Package Manager
nodes.description: Distribution and package management system for bread releases across multiple channels.

nodes.label: Semantic Versioning
nodes.description: Version format vX.Y.Z for stable, vX.Y.Z-rc.N for release candidates, X.Y.Z-dev.TIMESTAMP+SHA for dev builds.

nodes.label: Main Branch
nodes.description: Single long-lived branch where all day-to-day work lands; every push publishes dev-track build.

nodes.label: Feature Branch Pattern
nodes.description: Short-lived feature/ branches for new features, merged to main via PR and deleted.

nodes.label: Fix Branch Pattern
nodes.description: Short-lived fix/ branches for bug fixes, merged to main via PR and deleted.

nodes.label: Self-hosted Runner (hestia)
nodes.description: Custom runner used for all CI jobs to avoid unnecessary external build overhead.

nodes.label: Distribution Point: dl.breadway.dev
nodes.description: Central distribution server for all bread release tracks (dev, beta, stable).

nodes.label: GitHub Release Upload
nodes.description: Optional GitHub release mirror for stable releases, requires GH_RELEASE_TOKEN.

nodes.label: systemd User Service (breadd.service)
nodes.description: systemd user service unit that starts breadd after graphical session is available.

nodes.label: systemd Service Installation
nodes.description: Manual installation and enablement of breadd service with optional debug configuration.

nodes.label: bread-ecosystem Repository
nodes.description: Central ecosystem repository containing shared scripts, docs, and release infrastructure.

nodes.label: bread-shared Crate
nodes.description: Shared Rust types and definitions: RawEvent, BreadEvent, AdapterSource, KNOWN_APPS.

nodes.label: bread-utils Crate
nodes.description: Utilities crate with bread-client feature for IPC communication from sibling apps.

nodes.label: Breadclip Integration Reference
nodes.description: Reference implementation for integrating a bread* app with EVENTS.md documenting published events and commands.

nodes.label: API Stability Policy
nodes.description: Additive-only within v1, deprecation window, since-markers, and version discovery via api_version.

nodes.label: Hyprland Compositor
nodes.description: Wayland compositor used as primary target for Bread desktop automation.

nodes.label: Wayland Protocol
nodes.description: Modern display server protocol underlying Hyprland and other Linux desktop environments.

nodes.label: Linux System
nodes.description: Primary platform for Bread automation with Arch Linux recommended.

nodes.label: Rust Toolchain
nodes.description: Required stable Rust toolchain (2021 edition) for building Bread.

nodes.label: udev System
nodes.description: Device event system required on systemd-based Linux distributions.

nodes.label: UPower Service
nodes.description: Optional D-Bus service for battery and power events, falls back to sysfs without it.

nodes.label: rtnetlink Socket
nodes.description: Optional netlink socket for network events, falls back to sysfs polling without it.

nodes.label: BlueZ Service
nodes.description: Optional Bluetooth daemon for device events and Bluetooth control.

nodes.description: Check daemon connectivity.

nodes.label: CLI: health
nodes.description: Show daemon version, uptime, and PID.

nodes.description: Diagnose daemon and module health with JSON output option.

nodes.description: Hot-reload Lua modules with optional --watch for auto-reload.

nodes.label: CLI: state
nodes.description: Dump or query full runtime state as JSON with optional path filtering.

nodes.label: CLI: events
nodes.description: Stream live events with filtering, replay, and field selection options.

nodes.label: CLI: emit
nodes.description: Manually fire an event for testing purposes.

nodes.label: CLI: profile-list
nodes.description: List defined profiles.

nodes.label: CLI: profile-activate
nodes.description: Activate a named profile.

nodes.label: CLI: modules list
nodes.description: List installed modules and their daemon status.

nodes.label: CLI: modules install
nodes.description: Install a module from a local directory.

nodes.description: Remove an installed module with optional --yes confirmation skip.
